sample_unit: responses to common patient questions on third molar extraction

links.outcome: Readability (FKRE, FKGL) of ChatGPT responses to third molar extraction patient questions
links.effect: Responses exceeded the recommended level for the average patient (FKRE: 52; FKGL: 10), versus targets of FKRE >60 and FKGL <8.
links.quote: AI-generated responses above the recommended level for the average patient (FKRE: 52; FKGL: 10).

links.outcome: Presence of citations or references in ChatGPT responses
links.effect: All prompts did not provide citations or references.
links.quote: All prompts did not provide citations or references.

links.outcome: Whether AI deferred to provider when no definitive answer exists
links.effect: AI correctly deferred to the provider in instances where no definitive answer exists.
links.quote: AI correctly deferred to the provider in instances where no definitive answer exists.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and readability of ChatGPT for answering patient questions about third molar extraction without evaluating an operational deployment practice or guardrail.
